create.title: Hard-M1 t=1 rho-large P2 absolute-capacity sectors
create.statement_tex: Fix the exact accepted Round-192 hard-M1 original-t=1 rho-large core, its physical opposing-incidence source N=dm, N+r=d'm', all literal fields, the T=0/T>=1 Farey-core convention, both orientations and frequency signs, and one outer real part. Put g=(d,d'), D_L=ceil(sqrt L), and impose P_2=1_(|d-gm|<=D_L)1_(|d'-gm'|>D_L) on the physical source before Fourier expansion or height differencing. With kappa the inward physical cross gcd, the whole sector kappa>=D_L has fixed-packet size O(H_B \mathfrak m kappa u X^epsilon) and outer size O(L^2X^epsilon). On kappa<D_L the complete positive bound is |R_core,fix(P_2W)|<<u{kappa+min(Y,D_L)}X^epsilon. Hence every packet with min(Y,D_L)<=H_B \mathfrak m kappa is also target-safe, and the union of both safe sectors has outer size O(L^2X^epsilon) after the exact \mathfrak m^(-1) lift and accepted anchor, band, divisor and shell ledger. The exact remaining packet region is kappa<D_L and min(Y,D_L)>H_B \mathfrak m kappa. The large-kappa proof is the absolute count sum_(kappa>=D_L) D_L(1+L/kappa)^2<<L^2; the small-kappa proof combines fixed-height Yu and all-height D_Lu counts with the accepted kappa u terminal/Fejer cost. The transported physical-mask commutator, births, deaths, carries, endpoints, phases, cells, crossings and zero extensions remain in the recomputed core. Within one remaining row the far fibre has O(1) samples; the plus fixed-mode anchor ratio is carry-dependent and the minus ratio is one. Same-site event Gram blocks recombine to the original masked jump. Live squarefreeness gives only U^epsilon congruence multiplicity and does not control the actual cross-row ++,+-,-+,-- coefficient Gram. This node proves no complete P2, P1, complete original t=1 or t>=2 range, owner, parent, endpoint theorem, bridge, target, or exponent.
create.next_action: Prove the exact remaining P2 packet region kappa<D_L and min(Y,D_L)>H_B \mathfrak m kappa, or leave it open and attack the disjoint physical P1 complement in a separately frozen round. For the P2 remainder, form the joint ++,+-,-+,-- cross-row Gram only after exact same-site event recombination and retain actual endpoint products, square-root phases, Fejer factors, residual selectors, unequal translations, carries, births/deaths, physical-mask commutators, both T branches, zero extensions, and one outer real part. Within-row determinant multiplicity, anchor phases, arbitrary bounded arrays, separate orientation norms, or the squarefree root count alone are insufficient.

The condition min(Y,D_L)<=H_B \mathfrak m kappa is a strict packet subsector with an explicit reverse complement.
All displayed capacities are upper bounds; actual endpoint coefficients may vanish or cancel.
At one retained mode the plus ratio is carry-dependent (-1)^c e(a/q), not uniformly -e(a/q).
